entities.name: Williams
entities.description: Williams entered the British Touring Car Championship in 1995, taking over the works Renault programme.

entities.name: Alain Menu
entities.description: Menu was a championship contender and finished second in the championship with seven wins.

entities.name: Will Hoy
entities.description: Hoy had constant failures and bad luck during the first half of the season but won three races and scored several podium finishes in the second half of the year, eventually taking fourth in the championship.
The year Williams entered the British Touring Car Championship.
A more difficult year for Williams with the front-wheel-drive cars outclassed.
A breakthrough year for Williams, winning the drivers' championship with Menu.
